preconditions.description: The value of k is within the range from 0 to 104.
The value of m is within the range from 1 to 300,000.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly m lines.
Each line in the output contains exactly 8 digits.
All tickets in the output are distinct.

postconditions.expression: all(ticket.isdigit() and len(ticket) == 8 for ticket in output)
postconditions.description: Each ticket is a string of exactly 8 digits.

postconditions.expression: all(is_k_lucky(k, ticket) for ticket in output)
postconditions.description: Each ticket is k-lucky according to the given definition.
